lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu a(n)tar mal laagai maaiaa ke vaapaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: The filth of attachment to Maya clings to their hearts; they deal in Maya alone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰਾ ਜਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਆਵਣਿ ਜਾਣਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa ke vaapaaraa jagat piaaraa aavan jaan dukh paaee ||
lines.translation: They love to deal in Maya in this world; coming and going, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਬਿਸ੍ਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh kaa keeRaa bikh siu laagaa bistaa maahi samaaee ||
lines.translation: The worm of poison is addicted to poison; it is immersed in manure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਇ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo dhur likhiaa soi kamaavai koi na metanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He does what is pre-ordained for him; no one can erase his destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹੋਰਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੂਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਗਾਵਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate tin sadaa sukh paaiaa hor moorakh kook mue gaavaaraa ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, lasting peace is found; the ignorant fools die screaming. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਿਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohi man ra(n)giaa mohi sudh na kaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Their minds are colored by emotional attachment to Maya; because of this emotional attachment, they do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh ihu man ra(n)geeai doojaa ra(n)g jaaee raam ||
lines.translation: The soul of the Gurmukh is imbued with the Lord's Love; the love of duality departs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਜਾਈ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ਸਚਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojaa ra(n)g jaaee saach samaaee sach bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: The love of duality departs, and the soul merges in Truth; the warehouse is overflowing with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਬੂਝੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai soee boojhai sach savaaranahaaraa ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, comes to understand; the Lord embellishes him with Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mele so har milai hor kahanaa kichhoo na jaae ||
lines.translation: He alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord causes to merge; nothing else can be said or done.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਇਕਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vin naavai bharam bhulaaiaa ik naam rate ra(n)g laae ||4||5||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, one is deluded by doubt; but some, imbued with the Name, enshrine love for the Lord. ||4||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadaha(n)s mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਮੇਰਿਆ ਆਵਾ ਗਉਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man meriaa aavaa gaun sa(n)saar hai a(n)t sach nibeRaa raam ||
lines.translation: O my mind, the world comes and goes in birth and death; only the True Name shall emancipate you in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਚਾ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sachaa bakhas lae phir hoi na pheraa raam ||
lines.translation: When the True Lord Himself grants forgiveness, then one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir hoi na pheraa a(n)t sach nibeRaa guramukh milai vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: He does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again, and he is emancipated in the end; as Gurmukh, he obtains glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saachai ra(n)g raate sahaje maate sahaje rahe samaaee ||
lines.translation: Imbued with love for the True Lord, he is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and he remains absorbed in the Celestial Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਚੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa man bhaaiaa sach vasaaiaa sabad rate a(n)t niberaa ||
lines.translation: The True Lord is pleasing to his mind; he enshrines the True Lord in his mind; attuned to the Word of the Shabad, he is emancipated in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਣੇ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਫੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate se sach samaane bahur na bhavajal pheraa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, merge in the True Lord; they are not cast into the terrifying world-ocean again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh baral hai doojai bhaai khuaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Emotional attachment to Maya is total madness; through the love of duality, one is ruined.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਤਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਹੇਤੁ ਹੈ ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: maataa pitaa sabh het hai hete palachaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Mother and father - all are subject to this love; in this love, they are entangled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇਤੇ ਪਲਚਾਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ਮੇਟਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: hete palachaaee purab kamaaee met na sakai koee ||
lines.translation: They are entangled in this love, on account of their past actions, which no one can erase.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਾਜੀ ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin srisat saajee so kar vekhai tis jevad avar na koee ||
lines.translation: The One who created the Universe, beholds it; no other is as great as He.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧਾ ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਖਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh a(n)dhaa tap tap khapai bin sabadai saa(n)t na aaee ||
lines.translation: The blind, self-willed manmukh is consumed by his burning rage; without the Word of the Shabad, peace is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਭੁਲਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਖੁਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bin naavai sabh koee bhulaa maaiaa mohi khuaaee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Name, everyone is deluded, ruined by emotional attachment to Maya. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਲਤਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੈ ਭਜਿ ਪਏ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu jag jalataa dekh kai bhaj pae har saranaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Seeing that this world on fire, I have hurried to the Sanctuary of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਕਰਂੀ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਆਗੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: aradaas kara(n)ee gur poore aagai rakh levahu dehu vadaaee raam ||
lines.translation: I offer my prayer to the Perfect Guru: please save me, and bless me with Your glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rakh levahu saranaaee har naam vadaaee tudh jevad avar na daataa ||
lines.translation: Preserve me in Your Sanctuary, and bless me with the glorious greatness of the Name of the Lord; there is no other Giver as great as You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੇ ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa laage se vadabhaage jug jug eko jaataa ||
lines.translation: Those who are engaged in serving You are very fortunate; throughout the ages, they know the One Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਤੁ ਸਤੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jat sat sa(n)jam karam kamaavai bin gur gat nahee paaee ||
lines.translation: You may practice celibacy, truth, austere self-discipline and rituals, but without the Guru, you shall not be emancipated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੁਝਾਏ ਜੋ ਜਾਇ ਪਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tis no sabad bujhaae jo jaai pavai har saranaaee ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone understands the Word of the Shabad, who goes and seeks the Lord's Sanctuary. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਇ ਸਾ ਊਪਜੈ ਹੋਰ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har mat dei saa oopajai hor mat na kaaee raam ||
lines.translation: That understanding, imparted by the Lord, wells up; there is no other understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੁ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar ek too aape dehi bujhaaee raam ||
lines.translation: Deep within, and beyond as well, You alone are, O Lord; You Yourself impart this understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape dehi bujhaaee avar na bhaaee guramukh har ras chaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: One whom He Himself blesses with this understanding, does not love any other. As Gurmukh, he tastes the subtle essence of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਖਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dar saachai sadaa hai saachaa saachai sabad subhaakhiaa ||
lines.translation: In the True Court, he is forever True; with love, he chants the True Word of the Shabad.
